# OpenTopoX Examples

Run the examples from the repository root:

```sh
npm run serve
```

Then open one of these URLs:

- <http://127.0.0.1:5177/examples/basic-usage/>
- <http://127.0.0.1:5177/examples/cloud-resource-topology/>
- <http://127.0.0.1:5177/examples/preset-entry/>
- <http://127.0.0.1:5177/examples/minimal-realtime/>

Each example imports from `../../src/framework/index.js` so it can run directly
from a source checkout without a bundler.
